text:
Priya: heads up, promo stalled — deploy-bot flagged artifact layer size mismatch, holding promotion.
Dan: ugh, paste the deploy-bot output pls
Priya:
```
deploy-bot: promo job id=promo-2026-03-22-77
registry-fetch: GET registry.internal/repo/redwood/service:2026.03.22 -> 200
layer-verify: layer 3 expected size=4239042 got=4211200
deploy-bot: manifest verification failed: layer size mismatch
deploy-bot: pausing promotion; manual intervention required
```
Lee: curious — manifest vs actual layer size. Could be a registry GC partial rewrite or a streaming upload truncated a layer.
Marta: do we have a last-known-good digest for this tag?
Priya: release metadata shows digest sha256:aa11..44 and recorded layer sizes in metadata. Staging and canary both pulled the same digest earlier and passed smoke.
Dan: if staging and canary used same digest and passed, maybe the registry served a different blob during promotion (mirrored edge). Any mirror in front?
Priya: yes, we have a CDN mirror and a regional pullthrough cache. ops-team, any cache evictions or partial mirrors?
release-bot: CDN reported 206 partial responses from mirror-edge-3 at 03:18 UTC for objects >5MB. No bucket-level deletes.
Lee: 206 partials could mean range requests failing; could cause sizes to differ if client concatenates incorrectly.
Marta: options: 1) pin promotion to the artifact digest (force bypass manifest size check) and resume, 2) invalidate mirror and re-push artifact, 3) rollback the candidate and hold promo until investigation.
Dan: pinning bypasses a safety check — risky. If somehow the layer is corrupt on some edges, customers might get bad binary.
Priya: what's the current business urgency? This is a routine infra release, not hotfix. We can wait 45m.
Marta: then prefer option 2. I'll kick cache invalidation + re-push. Who owns the re-push?
Lee: I'll queue a CI re-publish: `ci/publish --release 2026.03.22 --force-multipart-rewrite`. Will also run a quick artifact verify job that streams the layer and verifies size/digest from multiple regions.
Dan: add a step to the promotion flow: fetch via origin (no CDN) for verification. That will protect against mirror inconsistencies in future.
Priya: agreed — add origin-verify flag for promo runs. For now don't pin.
release-bot: queued job publish-2026.03.22-rewrite by Lee. Expected ETA 28m.
Lee: started re-publish. Posting logs: `uploaded parts 1..8`, `complete multipart upload -> 201`, `registry manifest updated`
Lee: running cross-region verify: eu-west fetch OK size=4239042 digest matches; us-east fetch OK; ap-south fetch returned truncated stream previously but after re-push now OK.
Priya: staging canary re-smoke triggered automatically on new manifest.
Dan: smoke succeeded. sizes and digests consistent from origin and mirrors. Ready to resume promo in 5m.
Priya: resuming promotion now. deploy-bot: promotion resumed by Priya (reason=republish+verify).
deploy-bot: promotion completed successfully, new release 2026.03.22 cut.
Marta: leaving a note in release notes: "Fixed registry mirror partial responses causing layer size mismatch; republished artifacts and verified cross-region."
Priya: opening a short postmortem to capture root cause and add origin-verify to promotion template.
Dan: thanks all — nice coordinated response. :shipit:
